items.name: Grilled chicken breast, diced
items.preparation: grilled/roasted skinless chicken breast, cut into roughly 1.5-2 cm cubes

items.name: Cooking oil on chicken
items.preparation: residual oil implied by browned surfaces on the grilled chicken; not directly visible

scale_cues: Stainless steel mixing bowl (assumed ~25-28 cm rim diameter) filling the frame; individual grape tomatoes (~2.5-3 cm long, ~8 g each) used to size the chicken cubes and count pieces (~12 tomatoes, ~30-35 chicken cubes).
assumptions: Bowl is a standard ~25-28 cm mixing bowl; no cutlery or hand available for scale
White cubes are cooked skinless chicken breast (not tofu or paneer), based on fibrous texture and browned edges
Tomatoes are grape/cherry tomatoes at ~8 g each
No dressing or sauce visible; only a small amount of residual cooking oil assumed
Some chicken pieces are hidden beneath tomatoes and other cubes; a single shallow layer with slight piling assumed
